title: Transition Fill Days Supply and the Single-Fill Ceiling
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — the one transition fill of a non-formulary drug for a newly enrolled member.**

**Rule.** The transition fill is the plan's transition fill days supply — the transition fill days figure of the member's PrairieRx plan — and the transition fill days never exceed the plan's most days supply of one fill.

### Reading the rule

| Figure of the member's plan | Role |
|---|---|
| Transition fill days supply | The days the transition fill covers |
| Most days supply of one fill | The ceiling the transition fill days never exceed |

### Worked figures (hypothetical plan figures)

| Transition fill days supply | Most days supply of one fill | Transition fill days |
|---|---|---|
| 30 | 34 | 30 |
| 31 | 14 | 14 |

In the second row the ceiling of 14 days is the lower figure and holds the fill at 14 days.
